name: Permutation Group Orbit Disguise
description: Replaces the geometric orthogonal complement of incidence vectors with the equivalent algebraic condition of orbits under a permutation group generated by transpositions. Two elements are in the same orbit if and only if they are in the same connected component of the graph where the transpositions are edges. This preserves the minimum-cost Steiner tree structure exactly, while forcing models to reason about group actions rather than graph connectivity or spatial vectors.
